headline: Sensex Drops 318 Points as Inflation Concerns and Hawkish Fed Commentary Snap Three-Day Rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on broad market sentiment during trading.
Hawkish comments from the US Federal Reserve and rising crude oil prices pressured the Indian rupee.
Profit-taking in financial and auto stocks caused benchmark indices to snap their three-day winning streak.
Concerns over a 12-month high trade deficit dragged investor enthusiasm despite strong export data.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 318 points lower while Nifty 50 slipped below the 25,150 mark.
Paytm stock surged to record highs following preliminary RBI approval for a wallet licence.
Grasim Industries reported Q2FY27 net profit jumping to ₹2,306 crore, but faced market selling pressure.
Natco Pharma posted a 60.8% drop in Q2 net profit to ₹202.6 crore.
summary: Indian equity markets snapped a three-day winning streak as the Sensex dropped 318 points and Nifty closed below 25,150 due to inflation concerns and hawkish Fed signals. Key financial and auto stocks dragged indices down despite intraday recovery attempts and strong October export growth. Stock-specific action saw Paytm reach record highs on RBI wallet approval, while quarterly earnings results drove volatility in Grasim and Natco Pharma.
